category.name: Documents, OCR and presentations
category.description: Parse PDFs and scans, convert file formats, generate slides and collect e-signatures.

entries.name: Adobe PDF Services API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> obtained via OAuth Server-to-Server client_credentials grant (client_id/client_secret)
entries.free_tier: free tier: 500 document transactions/month, no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Programmatically create, convert, combine, compress, OCR, and extract data from PDF documents.
entries.notes: As of January 2025, JWT/service-account auth is deprecated; all new integrations must use OAuth Server-to-Server (2-legged client-credentials) via Adobe Developer Console.

entries.name: AWS Textract
entries.auth_hint: AWS SigV4-signed requests using IAM access key/secret or role credentials
entries.free_tier: free tier: 1,000 pages/month (DetectDocumentText & AnalyzeDocument, each) for first 3 months; AnalyzeExpense/AnalyzeID get 150 pages/month free
entries.desc_en: Detect and extract text, forms, tables, and data from scanned documents and images via API calls.
entries.notes: Requires an AWS account and IAM credentials; region-specific; free tier applies only for the first 3 months after the first Textract request; official AWS Labs MCP catalog exists (github.com/awslabs/mcp) but has no dedicated Textract server, only community ones.

entries.name: Azure AI Document Intelligence
entries.auth_hint: Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key: <key> header (Azure AD/Entra ID Bearer token also supported)
entries.free_tier: free tier: F0 pricing tier, 500 pages/month, rate-limited
entries.desc_en: Analyze forms, invoices, receipts, and scanned documents to extract structured JSON via REST API.
entries.notes: Auth via Azure subscription key or Entra ID (Azure AD) OAuth2; current GA version is 4.0; legacy v3.0 API scheduled to retire March 30, 2029; no official Microsoft MCP server specific to Document Intelligence, only community implementations and the general-purpose Azure MCP Server.

entries.name: CloudConvert API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY> (OAuth2 authorization-code/implicit flow also supported for user-facing apps)
entries.free_tier: free: 25 conversion minutes/day for the web tool; paid credit packages for the API; free Sandbox API for unlimited test jobs without consuming credits
entries.desc_en: Convert, compress, merge, watermark, and OCR files across 200+ formats via REST API or MCP.
entries.notes: Official MCP server at https://mcp.cloudconvert.com uses Streamable HTTP transport and authenticates via OAuth2 against the user's CloudConvert account (no API key needed for MCP); no public OpenAPI/Swagger file is served by CloudConvert itself.

entries.name: DocuSign eSignature API
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> via OAuth2 Authorization Code grant or JWT Grant
entries.free_tier: free developer/demo sandbox account (account-d.docusign.com) with unlimited test envelopes; production use requires a paid DocuSign plan
entries.desc_en: Send, sign, track, and manage electronic signature envelopes and agreement workflows via REST API.
entries.notes: Official Docusign MCP Server is in Open Beta and covers eSignature plus Navigator/Maestro/Workspaces; JWT grant requires one-time user consent; production API calls require a paid plan beyond the free developer sandbox.

entries.name: Gamma API
entries.auth_hint: X-API-KEY: <key> (OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens also accepted on the same endpoints)
entries.free_tier: paid only: requires Pro, Ultra, Teams, or Business plan; no free API tier
entries.desc_en: Generate, poll, and export AI-made presentations, documents, or social posts as PDF/PPTX via REST API.
entries.notes: Async workflow (POST /v1.0/generations then poll GET .../{id}); base URL https://public-api.gamma.app/v1.0; official remote MCP server is OAuth2-secured (RFC 7591 dynamic client registration).

entries.name: Google Document AI
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 access token> (service account) or API key for some endpoints
entries.free_tier: free tier: 1,000 pages/month per processor type, then $0.65-$10 per 1,000 pages
entries.desc_en: Extract text, tables, and structured data from documents like invoices, forms, and IDs via REST API.
entries.notes: Requires a GCP project and service-account/OAuth2 credentials (standard Google Cloud IAM auth); region-specific endpoints (global/us/eu); no official MCP server found.

entries.name: Google Slides / Docs API
entries.free_tier: free, no key (standard Google API usage quotas apply; requires GCP project + OAuth consent)
entries.desc_en: Read and programmatically edit Google Slides presentations (slides, shapes, text, tables) via REST API or MCP.
entries.notes: Official remote MCP server (slidesmcp.googleapis.com, tools: read_presentation, update_presentation) is part of the Google Workspace Developer Preview Program - limited/early access. Non-OpenAPI Discovery Doc available at https://slides.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v1.

entries.name: LlamaParse (LlamaCloud)
entries.free_tier: check pricing: credit-based at $1.25/1,000 credits (1-45+ credits/page depending on tier); 48h parse cache is free to re-query
entries.desc_en: Parse, classify, extract, and split complex documents (tables, forms, charts) into LLM-ready structured data via API.
entries.notes: Regional MCP endpoints: mcp.llamaindex.ai (North America) and mcp.eu.llamaindex.ai (Europe), sign in with LlamaCloud account. Pricing tiers: Fast/Cost-effective/Agentic/Agentic Plus.

entries.name: Mistral OCR API
entries.free_tier: paid only: $4/1,000 pages (OCR), $5/1,000 pages (Document AI); 50% off via Batch API; no free tier confirmed
entries.desc_en: Extract text, tables, and layout structure from PDFs and images as structured Markdown/JSON via REST API.
entries.notes: Fixed model id e.g. mistral-ocr-2512; block/table/bounding-box extraction requires OCR 4+/2512+; no official Mistral-maintained MCP server, only community implementations.

entries.name: PDF.co API
entries.free_tier: trial credits: 10,000 credits for 1 month, no credit card required
entries.desc_en: Convert, merge, split, edit, fill forms, OCR, and extract data from PDFs via REST API.
entries.notes: Base URL https://api.pdf.co/v1; credit-based usage pricing after trial; code samples (not formal SDKs) published at github.com/pdfdotco/pdf-co-api-samples.

entries.name: Reducto API
entries.free_tier: 15,000 free credits (~$150 value) for new Standard accounts; extra credits via Startup Program for qualifying early-stage teams
entries.desc_en: Parse, extract, split, edit, and classify complex documents into structured JSON/Markdown via REST API or SDKs.
entries.notes: Pay-as-you-go after free credits: ~$10/1,000 pages (Parse), ~$20/1,000 pages (Extract); official MCP repo at github.com/reductoai/mcp-server-reducto; hosted MCP variant does not support local file paths, only URLs.

entries.name: SlideSpeak API
entries.free_tier: check pricing (no free tier confirmed on docs; requires API key from developer settings)
entries.desc_en: Generate, edit, and download PowerPoint/PDF presentations from text, documents, or outlines via REST API.
entries.notes: Async task-based workflow with polling (GET /task_status/{task_id}); download URLs are short-lived; no official language SDK, only a Postman collection plus the MCP server.

entries.name: Unstructured API
entries.auth_hint: unstructured-api-key: <key> (verify exact header on api-reference page)
entries.free_tier: check pricing: low-cost entry tier plus Pay-As-You-Go per-page billing; no explicit free quota confirmed
entries.desc_en: Partition and extract structured elements (text, tables, layout) from PDFs, docs, and images for RAG pipelines via API.
entries.notes: Legacy /general/v0/general Partition endpoint is for prototyping single files; production use should use the Pipeline/Workflow API. Official MCP server (UNS-MCP) manages sources, destinations, workflows and jobs rather than one-shot partitioning.
